speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the timing of your symptoms: did the double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness start all at once, or did they develop gradually over time?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and relief with rest is classic for myasthenia gravis; has the double vision ever disappeared completely, and do you experience any drooping of your eyelids or difficulty swallowing?
